characters.name: 方晚
characters.design: 32-year-old female radio host with shoulder-length black hair pinned by a silver clip, wearing a deep burgundy button-up shirt and over-ear monitoring headphones. She has soft facial features and a calm, focused expression. Front close-up shot highlights her gentle empathetic look when speaking to the mic, with realistic skin texture and warm low-key lighting matching the studio ambient.

characters.name: 陈国平
characters.design: 47-year-old male taxi driver with short gray hair and dark stubble, wearing a dark blue work jacket. He has weary but kind facial features, with a worn old towel draped over the steering wheel beside him. Interior car close-up shot uses cool desaturated blue-grey tone, with faint street light seeping through the window to highlight his trembling expression holding back tears, showing realistic texture of the jacket and towel.

props.name: 监听耳机
props.design: Over-ear black monitoring headphones with soft padded ear cups and a flexible headband, worn on the host's head. Made of matte plastic and foam with no fancy decorations, with realistic texture. Close-up shot shows it fits naturally with the host's appearance, consistent with the late-night radio studio setting.

props.name: 方向盘旧毛巾
props.design: Worn cotton towel with faded color and small tears, casually draped over the taxi steering wheel. It has soft fabric texture and is slightly crumpled, consistent with the driver's long-term use. Medium close-up shot in the taxi interior uses cool dim light to show its worn state, highlighting the driver's hardworking identity.

issues: 设计要点要求68岁银灰发老人，画面为黑发中年男性
设计要点要求毛巾为褪色（faded color），画面为鲜艳紫色
设计要点要求冷光（cool dim light），画面光线偏暖

scenes.name: 深夜电台直播间
scenes.design: Realistic late-night radio studio with soundproof cotton walls, a mixing console with glowing faders, a warm desk lamp on the work desk, a pop filter and professional microphone placed in front of the host. The overall tone is warm and muted, with low-key soft lighting, supporting close-up and medium shot perspectives, accurately restoring the late-night broadcast room atmosphere.

scenes.name: 深夜出租车驾驶舱
scenes.design: Realistic late-night taxi driver's cabin, with faint street light seeping through the window, small hanging ornaments swaying slightly, a dashboard with faint glow, and a worn old towel on the steering wheel. The overall tone is cool desaturated blue-grey, with dim ambient light that conveys the engine low-noise atmosphere, supporting medium close-up and close-up perspectives, accurately restoring the late-night driving environment.
